[SWS_CRYPT_01660]
⌈
The CryptoAPI shall provide a seek functionality.
This allows to set the position of the next byte within the stream of the encryption /
decryption gamma. An offset value in bytes is used setting the relative, to starting point,
or current position in the gamma stream. It is possible to indicate if the starting point
for positioning is within the stream from the starting point or from the current position.
⌋
